newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end quiet trade mostly firmer.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end quiet trade mostly firmer.

text.p: Sept 16 - IMM currency futures ended quiet trading mostly firmer. Traders looked for more consolidation nearterm and profittaking on currency downturn since early September. They said Monday's extended rise in U.S. stocks had little effect despite pressure on Friday from stock rally. Tuesday's U.S. capacity use, industrial output seen not having much impact. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
